how_to_cite: Weiskittel, A. R. (2026). PERSEUS Forest Intelligence: a CONUS multi-model forest carbon, value, and risk decision-support tool. Center for Research on Sustainable Forests, University of Maine. holoros.github.io/perseus-forest-intelligence
note: Registry of the datasets and models behind PERSEUS. Deposited products carry a Zenodo DOI; upstream products carry their canonical citation. DOIs confirmed published via the Zenodo API 2026-07-02 (harvest_decision_v5, stumpage_price_db added this cycle).

fvs_production.name: Production FVS engine evidence (paired growth-by-mortality matrix + Bakuzis assessment)

cbm_conus.name: CBM-CONUS multi-model forest-carbon trajectories and reproduction code (concept DOI)
cbm_conus.note: Concept DOI, resolves to the latest version; 48-state trajectories, rollups, decompositions.

harvest_decision_v5.name: CONUS-HCS: a continental harvest decision-surface product (240 m annual harvest probability), v5
harvest_decision_v5.note: Concept DOI, resolves to the latest version (v5.0.1, 10.5281/zenodo.20837629); 240 m annual harvest probability and clearcut/partial decision surfaces. The companion manuscript was withdrawn from submission on 1 October 2026 for a refit (GRM cut based harvest positive class); a revised product version is expected.

stumpage_price_db.name: A harmonized CONUS stumpage price database (1995-2026, 2020 USD): multi-source compilation
stumpage_price_db.note: Concept DOI, resolves to the latest version (v1.0.1, 10.5281/zenodo.20837628); deposited source behind the region-aware blended stumpage (econ_params). The companion manuscript was withdrawn from submission on 1 October 2026 for a refit (species group by region price model with a series term); a revised product version is expected.

treemap_2022.name: TreeMap 2022: tree-level model of the forests of the conterminous United States
treemap_2022.authors: Riley, K. L., Grenfell, I. C., Finney, M. A., et al.

fia_fiadb.name: USDA Forest Service Forest Inventory and Analysis Database (FIADB)
fia_fiadb.authors: USDA Forest Service, Forest Inventory and Analysis Program

harris_2025_ownership.name: Spatial forest ownership of the conterminous United States (US_forest_ownership)

timbermart_south.name: TimberMart-South stumpage price series (with state-agency supplements)

maine_agb_yield_curves.name: Generic aboveground biomass yield curves for Maine forest types and ecoregions from FIA remeasurements (v1.0.0)
maine_agb_yield_curves.note: Six Maine forest type groups by six ecological sections, 0 to 250 yr: median and mean curves, 95% plot cluster bootstrap bands, PI90, cap and extrapolation flags. Published 2026-10-15.

lakes_nhvt_agb_yield_curves.name: FIA remeasurement AGB yield curves for NH, VT, MI, WI and MN
lakes_nhvt_agb_yield_curves.note: CRSF Cardinal builds of 16 October 2026, same method as the Maine record; Zenodo deposit pending

rdgrowth_thresholds.name: Relative density thresholds for growth and mortality by forest type and EPA Level III ecoregion (Supplementary Data S1 of: Evaluating relative density-stand dynamics relationships across contrasting forest types of the conterminous United States; submitted to Forest Ecology and Management)
rdgrowth_thresholds.authors: Chivhenge, E., Weiskittel, A. R., Ray, D., Woodall, C. W., D'Amato, A. W., Daigneault, A.
rdgrowth_thresholds.note: Concept DOI, resolves to the latest version; Supplementary Data S1 is unchanged across versions. 2,020 type by ecoregion cells with 95% intervals and source codes.
